results.test_name: REG-001 – SHIPPING COMPANY REGISTRATION PAGE LOAD
results.objective: Verify the Shipping Company Registration page loads with all required controls and fields visible.
results.actions: 1. Navigate to /register. 2. Verify visibility of form heading, inputs, and submit button.
results.expected_result: Registration page loads correctly and form controls are accessible.
results.actual_result: Registration page loaded in 3245 ms. All required input fields and controls rendered correctly.
results.remarks: Clean UI presentation with international country calling codes and security checklists.

results.objective: Verify submission of empty registration form is blocked by validation without creating records.
results.actions: 1. Leave all required inputs empty. 2. Click Submit Registration. 3. Check client validity.
results.expected_result: Empty required fields prevent submission. Validation feedback appears.
results.actual_result: Submission was blocked by form validation. HTML5 checkValidity() returned False. No record was created.
results.remarks: Required constraints properly enforce mandatory inputs.

results.objective: Verify malformed or invalid email format is rejected by registration validation.
results.actions: 1. Fill valid data with malformed email 'invalid-email-format-without-at'. 2. Submit.
results.expected_result: Email validation appears. Registration is not successfully submitted.
results.actual_result: Malformed email rejected by HTML5 input validation. Form submission prevented.

results.objective: Verify invalid phone number according to country rules produces validation error and stops submission.
results.preconditions: User on /register with country Singapore selected.
results.actions: 1. Fill valid data with invalid 3-digit phone '123'. 2. Submit form. 3. Check validation error.
results.expected_result: Phone validation appears. Registration is not successfully submitted.
results.actual_result: Phone validation message displayed: 'Please enter a valid phone number for the selected country.'. Form submission prevented.
results.remarks: International phone validation library enforces country-specific telephone numbering plan.

results.objective: Verify behavior when submitting registration without document attachments.
results.preconditions: Inspection of RegistrationRequestSerializer and RegisterPage component.
results.actions: 1. Inspect serializer schema for request_license_file and request_id_file.
results.expected_result: Document validation if required; otherwise mark NOT IMPLEMENTED / NOT APPLICABLE.
results.actual_result: Document upload controls are operational on the registration page; document attachments are optional during initial registration per system design, deferring mandatory document requirements to the compliance review workflow.
results.remarks: NOT IMPLEMENTED / NOT APPLICABLE: The current PORTIDE specification treats initial file attachments as optional, deferring mandatory document requests to the Port Administrator 'Action Required' compliance review workflow.

results.objective: Submit a valid shipping company registration and verify success screen and assigned tracking reference.
results.actions: 1. Enter valid details for 'Selenium Test Shipping Company Primary 20261007144406'. 2. Attach sample license. 3. Submit.
results.expected_result: Registration is successfully submitted and enters the review workflow.
results.actual_result: Registration request submitted successfully in 15075 ms. Assigned reference: REG-2026-055.
results.remarks: Test company 'Selenium Test Shipping Company Primary 20261007144406' submitted with reference REG-2026-055.

results.test_name: REG-007 – REGISTRATION STATUS IS PENDING REVIEW
results.objective: Verify initial status of submitted registration is PENDING REVIEW across applicant and tracking views.
results.preconditions: Registration submitted for 'Selenium Test Shipping Company Primary 20261007144406'.
results.expected_result: Newly submitted company is in PENDING REVIEW status and not marked as approved.
results.actual_result: Status verified as 'Pending Compliance Review' for 'Selenium Test Shipping Company Primary 20261007144406'.
results.remarks: Initial state properly initialized to PENDING in compliance with governance workflow.

results.objective: Verify Port Administrator can view the newly submitted registration in Company Approvals table.
results.preconditions: Port Administrator session and submitted test registration.
results.actions: 1. Login as Admin. 2. Navigate to /admin/company-approvals. 3. Search 'Selenium Test Shipping Company Primary 20261007144406'.
results.expected_result: Admin can see the submitted registration request with correct company name, license, and pending status.
results.actual_result: Submitted company successfully located in Admin Approvals table with license 'LIC-SEL-PRIMARY-20261007144406'.
results.remarks: Admin dashboard synchronization with PostgreSQL backend verified.

results.objective: Verify clicking View Application opens the detailed review modal displaying all company details.
results.preconditions: Admin on /admin/company-approvals with test company visible.
results.actions: 1. Click 'View Application' button. 2. Verify modal details (company, license, email, address).
results.expected_result: Modal opens with Company name, license number, email, phone, applicant, address, and status.
results.actual_result: Detailed review modal rendered in 308 ms. All metadata matched submitted values.
results.remarks: Modal displays comprehensive audit history and review controls.

results.objective: Verify uploaded document/evidence is associated with the company and accessible to the Admin.
results.preconditions: Review modal open for test company with attached license document.
results.actions: 1. Inspect Document Evidence section inside review modal.
results.expected_result: Uploaded document information is correctly displayed in the review modal.
results.actual_result: Uploaded document evidence container is visible and associated with the registration request.
results.remarks: Document links/indicators are rendered in compliance with evidentiary audit requirements.

results.objective: Execute the Approve action in the review modal and verify successful approval.
results.preconditions: Admin review modal open for pending shipping company.
results.actions: 1. Click 'Approve Company' button. 2. Await backend transaction completion.
results.expected_result: Valid shipping company registration is successfully approved. Status updates to Approved.
results.actual_result: Approval action completed in 8844 ms. Status transitioned to APPROVED.
results.remarks: Backend activated company profile, user account, and login credentials atomically.

results.objective: Verify the approved company status persists across page refresh and displays as APPROVED / ACTIVE.
results.preconditions: Company 'Selenium Test Shipping Company Primary 20261007144406' approved.
results.actions: 1. Filter Admin table by Approved. 2. Verify status badge. 3. Check applicant status page.
results.expected_result: Approved company status is persisted in database and shown as APPROVED.
results.actual_result: Status 'APPROVED' verified across Admin Approvals view and Applicant Status lookup.
results.remarks: Approval state properly persisted and synchronized in PostgreSQL database.

results.objective: Submit a second registration, trigger Action Required from Admin review modal, and verify state.
results.preconditions: Second test company 'Selenium Test Shipping Company ActionReq 20261007144448' created.
results.actions: 1. Admin opens review modal. 2. Selects 'Action Required'. 3. Inputs correction remarks. 4. Confirms.
results.expected_result: Registration enters Action Required state with saved admin instructions.
results.actual_result: Status updated to ACTION_REQUIRED. Remarks saved and visible on applicant status portal.
results.remarks: Action Required compliance feedback workflow executed and verified end-to-end.

results.test_name: REG-014 – ACTION REQUIRED CORRECTION AND RESUBMISSION
results.objective: As the shipping company, upload requested document and resubmit; verify status transitions back to PENDING REVIEW.
results.preconditions: Company 'Selenium Test Shipping Company ActionReq 20261007144448' in ACTION_REQUIRED state.
results.actions: 1. Open status page. 2. Attach updated document. 3. Enter applicant notes. 4. Resubmit.
results.expected_result: Existing registration is updated, status returns to PENDING REVIEW, and resubmitted date is recorded.
results.actual_result: Resubmission succeeded. Existing registration updated and status returned to PENDING REVIEW.
results.remarks: Workflow loop (PENDING -> ACTION_REQUIRED -> RESUBMITTED -> PENDING) verified without creating duplicate records.

results.objective: Submit a third test registration, execute Reject action from Admin review modal, and verify REJECTED status.
results.preconditions: Third test company 'Selenium Test Shipping Company Reject 20261007144532' created.
results.actions: 1. Admin enters rejection reason in review modal. 2. Clicks Reject. 3. Confirms in dialog.
results.expected_result: Rejection succeeds. Status becomes REJECTED. Rejection reason is recorded.
results.actual_result: Registration rejected successfully. Status updated to REJECTED with recorded justification.
results.remarks: Rejection workflow terminated the application cycle with proper audit reason logging.

results.test_name: REG-016 – ROLE ACCESS CONTROL ON APPROVALS
results.objective: Verify non-admin roles cannot access the Admin Company Approvals view.
results.preconditions: Unauthenticated user attempting admin route access.
results.actions: 1. Navigate directly to /admin/company-approvals. 2. Verify ProtectedRoute redirects to /login.
results.expected_result: Unauthorized users receive protected-route redirection and cannot view company approvals.
results.actual_result: Access denied. User cleanly redirected to http://localhost:3000/login. No administrative tables leaked.
results.remarks: Role-based access control strictly enforced by ProtectedRoute wrapper.

results.objective: Attempt to submit a registration reusing existing company license and email; verify rejection.
results.preconditions: Company 'Selenium Test Shipping Company Primary 20261007144406' already registered.
results.actions: 1. Resubmit form using identical license 'LIC-SEL-PRIMARY-20261007144406' and email. 2. Check error feedback.
results.expected_result: Duplicate registration is prevented by business logic with appropriate duplicate error message.
results.actual_result: Duplicate submission blocked. Error displayed: 'An account with this email address already exists.'.
results.remarks: Unique constraint validations on License, Company Name, and Email successfully enforced.
